target_audience: Tech-savvy professionals and entrepreneurs (25–40); Gen Z university students; Bangladesh primary, South Asian tech markets secondary

voice.tone: Intelligent, elevated, localized — explains complex technology in human terms

do_not_use: Cluttered layouts with excessive tech specs (max 3 specs per poster)
Fonts other than Lora or Hind Siliguri
Drop shadows or 3D effects on logo
Unapproved logo colors outside Horizon Navy, Aether Breeze, or Titanium White
Loud retail badges or aggressive sale bursts
